name: animated-sidebar
title: Animated Sidebar
description: Compose nested navigation with expanded, icon-only and mobile drawer presentations.

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, provide } from "vue";
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { EASE_DRAWER } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
import { useSidebar } from "./context";
import MobileSidebar from "./MobileSidebar.vue";
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    side?: "left" | "right";
    variant?: "sidebar" | "floating" | "inset";
    collapsible?: "icon" | "offcanvas" | "none";
    ariaLabel?: string;
    panelClassName?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    side: "left",
    variant: "sidebar",
    collapsible: "icon",
    ariaLabel: "Sidebar",
  },
);
const ctx = useSidebar(),
  collapsed = computed(
    () => !ctx.mobile.value && props.collapsible !== "none" && !ctx.open.value,
  ),
  offcanvas = computed(
    () => collapsed.value && props.collapsible === "offcanvas",
  );
provide("orvui-sidebar-panel", {
  collapsed,
  side: computed(() => props.side),
  collapsible: computed(() => props.collapsible),
});
const width = computed(() =>
  offcanvas.value
    ? "0px"
    : collapsed.value
      ? "var(--sidebar-width-icon)"
      : "var(--sidebar-width)",
);
</script>
<template>
  <MobileSidebar
    v-if="ctx.mobile.value"
    v-bind="$attrs"
    :side="side"
    :aria-label="ariaLabel"
    ><slot /></MobileSidebar
  ><motion.aside
    v-else
    v-bind="$attrs"
    :initial="false"
    :aria-label="ariaLabel"
    data-slot="sidebar"
    :data-state="collapsed ? 'collapsed' : 'expanded'"
    :data-collapsible="collapsible"
    :data-variant="variant"
    :data-side="side"
    :animate="{ width }"
    :transition="
      ctx.reduce.value
        ? { duration: 0 }
        : { type: 'spring', stiffness: 380, damping: 35, mass: 0.75 }
    "
    :class="
      cn(
        'group/sidebar peer relative hidden h-auto shrink-0 md:block will-change-[width]',
        side === 'right' && 'order-last',
        $attrs.class,
      )
    "
    ><motion.div
      :initial="false"
      :animate="{
        opacity: offcanvas ? 0 : 1,
        x: offcanvas ? (side === 'left' ? '-100%' : '100%') : '0%',
      }"
      :transition="{
        duration: ctx.reduce.value ? 0.16 : 0.36,
        ease: EASE_DRAWER,
      }"
      :inert="offcanvas || undefined"
      :class="
        cn(
          'sticky top-0 flex h-svh w-full flex-col overflow-hidden bg-background',
          collapsible === 'offcanvas' && 'w-[var(--sidebar-width)]',
          variant === 'sidebar' &&
            (side === 'left'
              ? 'border-border border-r'
              : 'border-border border-l'),
          variant === 'floating' &&
            'm-2 h-[calc(100svh-1rem)] rounded-2xl border border-border shadow-sm',
          variant === 'inset' && 'm-2 h-[calc(100svh-1rem)] rounded-2xl',
          panelClassName,
        )
      "
      ><slot /></motion.div
  ></motion.aside>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { X } from "lucide-vue-next";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
import { useSidebar } from "./context";
const ctx = useSidebar();
function close(event: MouseEvent) {
  if (!event.defaultPrevented)
    (ctx.mobile.value ? ctx.setOpenMobile : ctx.setOpen)(false);
}
</script>
<template>
  <button
    type="button"
    aria-label="Close sidebar"
    :class="
      cn(
        'inline-flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring',
        $attrs.class,
      )
    "
    @click="close"
  >
    <slot><X class="size-4" /></slot>
  </button>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
const layout =
  "relative flex min-h-svh min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col bg-background md:peer-data-[variant=inset]:m-2 md:peer-data-[variant=inset]:ml-0 md:peer-data-[variant=inset]:rounded-2xl md:peer-data-[variant=inset]:shadow-sm";
</script>
<template>
  <motion.main data-slot="sidebar-inset" :class="cn(layout, $attrs.class)"
    ><slot
  /></motion.main>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { SharedLayoutBg } from "../../shared-layout-bg";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
const list = "flex w-full min-w-0 list-none flex-col gap-0.5";
</script>
<template>
  <SharedLayoutBg
    as="ul"
    :inset="0"
    pill-class-name="rounded-xl bg-muted/70"
    pill-container-class-name="inset-y-auto top-0 h-9"
    data-slot="sidebar-menu"
    :class="cn(list, $attrs.class)"
    ><slot
  /></SharedLayoutBg>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useSlots } from "vue";
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { ChevronRight } from "lucide-vue-next";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
import { SPRING_LAYOUT, SPRING_PRESS, EASE_OUT } from "../../../lib/ease";
import RenderContent from "../../../lib/RenderContent";
import { useSidebar, useSidebarPanel } from "./context";
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    href?: string;
    isActive?: boolean;
    ariaExpanded?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    closeOnSelect?: boolean;
    icon?: any;
    badge?: any;
    target?: string;
    rel?: string;
  }>(),
  { ariaExpanded: undefined, closeOnSelect: undefined },
);
const emit = defineEmits(["select"]),
  ctx = useSidebar(),
  panel = useSidebarPanel(),
  slots = useSlots();
const textLabel = computed(() =>
  slots
    .default?.()
    .flatMap((node) =>
      typeof node.children === "string" ? [node.children] : [],
    )
    .join(""),
);
const textTransition = computed(() => ({
  duration: ctx.reduce.value ? 0.16 : panel.collapsed.value ? 0.12 : 0.2,
  delay: !ctx.reduce.value && !panel.collapsed.value ? 0.08 : 0,
  ease: EASE_OUT,
}));
function select(event: MouseEvent) {
  const blocked = props.disabled;
  if (blocked) event.preventDefault();
  if (blocked || event.defaultPrevented) return;
  emit("select");
  if (ctx.mobile.value) {
    const closeAfterSelection =
      props.closeOnSelect === undefined
        ? props.ariaExpanded === undefined
        : props.closeOnSelect;
    if (closeAfterSelection) ctx.setOpenMobile(false);
    return;
  }
  if (props.ariaExpanded !== undefined && panel.collapsed.value) {
    ctx.setOpen(true);
  }
}
</script>
<template>
  <component
    :is="href ? motion.a : motion.button"
    v-bind="$attrs"
    :type="href ? undefined : 'button'"
    :href="href"
    :target="target"
    :rel="rel ?? (target === '_blank' ? 'noreferrer noopener' : undefined)"
    :disabled="href ? undefined : disabled"
    :aria-current="isActive ? 'page' : undefined"
    :aria-expanded="ariaExpanded"
    :aria-disabled="disabled || undefined"
    :aria-label="panel.collapsed.value ? textLabel : undefined"
    :title="panel.collapsed.value ? textLabel : undefined"
    :tabindex="href && disabled ? -1 : undefined"
    :while-press="ctx.reduce.value || disabled ? undefined : { scale: 0.98 }"
    :transition="SPRING_PRESS"
    :class="
      cn(
        'relative flex min-h-9 w-full min-w-0 items-center gap-2.5 overflow-hidden rounded-xl px-3 text-left text-sm font-medium outline-none text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:text-foreground focus-visible:bg-muted/70 focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring',
        isActive && 'text-foreground',
        disabled && 'cursor-not-allowed opacity-40',
        $attrs.class,
      )
    "
    @click="select"
    ><motion.span
      v-if="isActive"
      :layout-id="ctx.id + '-active'"
      :transition="ctx.reduce.value ? { duration: 0 } : SPRING_LAYOUT"
      class="absolute inset-0 rounded-xl bg-muted" /><span
      v-if="icon || slots.icon"
      aria-hidden="true"
      class="relative z-10 grid size-5 shrink-0 place-items-center"
      ><slot name="icon"><RenderContent :node="icon" /></slot></span
    ><motion.span
      :initial="false"
      :animate="{
        opacity: panel.collapsed.value ? 0 : 1,
        x: panel.collapsed.value ? -4 : 0,
      }"
      :transition="textTransition"
      :aria-hidden="panel.collapsed.value"
      :class="
        cn(
          'relative z-10 min-w-0 flex-1 truncate',
          panel.collapsed.value && 'pointer-events-none',
        )
      "
      ><slot /></motion.span
    ><span
      v-if="badge && !panel.collapsed.value"
      class="relative z-10 shrink-0 text-xs text-muted-foreground"
      ><RenderContent :node="badge" /></span
    ><motion.span
      v-if="ariaExpanded !== undefined"
      aria-hidden="true"
      :initial="false"
      :animate="{
        opacity: panel.collapsed.value ? 0 : 1,
        rotate: ariaExpanded ? 90 : 0,
        x: panel.collapsed.value ? 4 : 0,
      }"
      :transition="ctx.reduce.value ? { duration: 0 } : SPRING_LAYOUT"
      class="relative z-10 grid size-4 shrink-0 place-items-center text-muted-foreground"
      ><ChevronRight class="size-3.5" /></motion.span
  ></component>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { SPRING_LAYOUT } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
const layout = "position" as const;
</script>
<template>
  <motion.li
    :layout="layout"
    :transition="SPRING_LAYOUT"
    data-slot="sidebar-menu-item"
    :class="cn('relative', $attrs.class)"
    ><slot
  /></motion.li>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "motion-v";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
import { useSidebar, useSidebarPanel } from "./context";
import { submenuVariants } from "./transitions";
const props = defineProps<{ open: boolean }>(),
  ctx = useSidebar(),
  panel = useSidebarPanel();
const present = computed(() => props.open && !panel.collapsed.value);
const movement = computed(() =>
  ctx.reduce.value
    ? {
        initial: false as const,
        animate: { opacity: 1 },
        exit: { opacity: 0 },
        transition: { duration: 0.12 },
      }
    : {
        variants: submenuVariants,
        initial: "closed",
        animate: "open",
        exit: "closed",
      },
);
</script>
<template>
  <AnimatePresence :initial="false" mode="popLayout"
    ><motion.ul
      v-if="present"
      key="sidebar-submenu"
      v-bind="movement"
      data-slot="sidebar-menu-sub"
      :class="
        cn(
          'relative mt-1 ml-5 flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-0.5 border-border border-l pl-3',
          $attrs.class,
        )
      "
      ><slot /></motion.ul
  ></AnimatePresence>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
import { SPRING_PRESS } from "../../../lib/ease";
import RenderContent from "../../../lib/RenderContent";
import { useSidebar } from "./context";
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    href?: string;
    isActive?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    closeOnSelect?: boolean;
    icon?: any;
    target?: string;
    rel?: string;
  }>(),
  { closeOnSelect: true },
);
const emit = defineEmits(["select"]),
  ctx = useSidebar();
function select(event: MouseEvent) {
  const blocked = props.disabled;
  if (blocked) event.preventDefault();
  const accepted = !blocked && !event.defaultPrevented;
  if (accepted) {
    emit("select");
    const dismissMobile = ctx.mobile.value && props.closeOnSelect;
    if (dismissMobile) ctx.setOpenMobile(false);
  }
}
</script>
<template>
  <component
    :is="href ? motion.a : motion.button"
    v-bind="$attrs"
    :href="href"
    :type="href ? undefined : 'button'"
    :target="target"
    :rel="rel ?? (target === '_blank' ? 'noreferrer noopener' : undefined)"
    :disabled="href ? undefined : disabled"
    :aria-current="isActive ? 'page' : undefined"
    :aria-disabled="disabled || undefined"
    :tabindex="href && disabled ? -1 : undefined"
    :while-press="ctx.reduce.value || disabled ? undefined : { scale: 0.98 }"
    :transition="SPRING_PRESS"
    :class="
      cn(
        'flex min-h-8 w-full min-w-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-2 text-left text-xs outline-none text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-muted/60 hover:text-foreground focus-visible:bg-muted/70 focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring',
        isActive && 'bg-muted/70 text-foreground',
        disabled && 'cursor-not-allowed opacity-40',
        $attrs.class,
      )
    "
    @click="select"
    ><span aria-hidden="true" class="grid size-4 shrink-0 place-items-center"
      ><slot name="icon"
        ><RenderContent v-if="icon" :node="icon" /><span
          v-else
          class="size-1 rounded-full bg-current" /></slot></span
    ><span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate"><slot /></span
  ></component>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
import { submenuItemVariants } from "./transitions";
const base = "relative min-w-0";
</script>
<template>
  <motion.li
    :variants="submenuItemVariants"
    data-slot="sidebar-menu-sub-item"
    :class="cn(base, $attrs.class)"
    ><slot
  /></motion.li>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
import { useSidebar, useSidebarPanel } from "./context";
const ctx = useSidebar(),
  panel = useSidebarPanel();
const rail =
  "absolute inset-y-0 z-20 hidden w-4 -translate-x-1/2 outline-none md:block after:absolute after:inset-y-0 after:left-1/2 after:w-px after:bg-transparent after:transition-colors hover:after:bg-border data-[side=right]:right-0 data-[side=right]:translate-x-1/2 data-[side=left]:left-full";
</script>
<template>
  <button
    type="button"
    :data-side="panel.side.value"
    tabindex="-1"
    aria-label="Toggle sidebar"
    title="Toggle sidebar"
    :class="cn(rail, $attrs.class)"
    @click="!$event.defaultPrevented && ctx.toggle()"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import { PanelLeft } from "lucide-vue-next";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
import { useSidebar } from "./context";
const ctx = useSidebar(),
  trigger = ctx.triggerRef,
  expanded = computed(() =>
    ctx.mobile.value ? ctx.mobileOpen.value : ctx.open.value,
  );
function click(event: MouseEvent) {
  if (!event.defaultPrevented) ctx.toggle();
}
</script>
<template>
  <button
    ref="trigger"
    type="button"
    aria-label="Toggle sidebar"
    :aria-expanded="expanded"
    data-slot="sidebar-trigger"
    :data-state="expanded ? 'expanded' : 'collapsed'"
    :class="
      cn(
        'inline-flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-background',
        $attrs.class,
      )
    "
    @click="click"
  >
    <slot><PanelLeft class="size-4" /></slot>
  </button>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from "vue";
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { useOverlay } from "../../../lib/composables";
import { EASE_DRAWER } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
import { useSidebar } from "./context";
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{ side?: "left" | "right"; ariaLabel?: string }>(),
  { side: "left", ariaLabel: "Sidebar" },
);
const ctx = useSidebar(),
  panel = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null),
  hidden = ref(!ctx.mobileOpen.value);
watch(
  ctx.mobileOpen,
  (value) => {
    if (value) hidden.value = false;
  },
  { flush: "sync" },
);
useOverlay(ctx.mobileOpen, panel, () => {
  ctx.mobileOpen.value = false;
});
const destination = computed(() => ({
  opacity: ctx.reduce.value ? (ctx.mobileOpen.value ? 1 : 0) : 1,
  x: ctx.reduce.value
    ? 0
    : ctx.mobileOpen.value
      ? "0%"
      : props.side === "left"
        ? "-100%"
        : "100%",
}));
const transition = computed(() => ({
  duration: ctx.reduce.value ? 0.16 : 0.36,
  ease: EASE_DRAWER,
}));
function complete() {
  if (!ctx.mobileOpen.value) hidden.value = true;
}
</script>
<template>
  <Teleport to="body"
    ><div
      :class="[
        'pointer-events-none fixed left-0 top-0 z-50 size-0 md:hidden',
        hidden && !ctx.mobileOpen.value ? 'invisible' : 'visible',
      ]"
    >
      <motion.button
        type="button"
        aria-label="Close sidebar"
        :tabindex="ctx.mobileOpen.value ? 0 : -1"
        :initial="false"
        :animate="{ opacity: ctx.mobileOpen.value ? 1 : 0 }"
        :transition="transition"
        :class="[
          'fixed inset-0 bg-black/40',
          ctx.mobileOpen.value ? 'pointer-events-auto' : 'pointer-events-none',
        ]"
        @click="ctx.mobileOpen.value = false"
      /><motion.div
        ref="panel"
        v-bind="$attrs"
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        :aria-label="ariaLabel"
        :aria-hidden="!ctx.mobileOpen.value"
        :inert="!ctx.mobileOpen.value || undefined"
        tabindex="-1"
        data-mobile="true"
        :data-state="ctx.mobileOpen.value ? 'expanded' : 'collapsed'"
        :data-side="side"
        :initial="false"
        :animate="destination"
        :transition="transition"
        :class="
          cn(
            'pointer-events-auto fixed inset-y-0 flex h-dvh w-(--sidebar-width-mobile) max-w-[88vw] flex-col overflow-hidden border-border bg-background shadow-2xl will-change-transform',
            side === 'left' ? 'left-0 border-r' : 'right-0 border-l',
            !ctx.mobileOpen.value && 'pointer-events-none',
            $attrs.class,
          )
        "
        @animation-complete="complete"
        ><slot
      /></motion.div></div
  ></Teleport>
</template>
export { useSidebar as useAnimatedSidebar } from "./context";

export { default as SharedLayoutBg } from "./src/SharedLayoutBg.vue";

export type * from "./src/api-types";

<script lang="ts">
import { Comment, Fragment, cloneVNode, defineComponent, h, isVNode, mergeProps, ref, useId, type PropType, type VNode, type VNodeChild } from "vue";
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from "motion-v";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
import { SPRING_LAYOUT } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { useReducedMotion } from "../../../lib/composables";
export interface SharedLayoutBgProps { as?: "div" | "ul"; pillClassName?: string; inset?: number; pillContainerClassName?: string }
function children(nodes: unknown[]): VNode[] {
  return nodes.flatMap(node => !isVNode(node) || node.type === Comment ? [] : node.type === Fragment && Array.isArray(node.children) ? children(node.children) : typeof node.type === "symbol" ? [] : [node]);
}
function replaceContents(child: VNode, additions: Record<string, unknown>, contents: VNode[]) {
  const result = cloneVNode(child, additions, true);
  const component = (child.shapeFlag & 6) !== 0;
  result.children = component ? { ...(child.children && typeof child.children === "object" && !Array.isArray(child.children) ? child.children : {}), default: () => contents } : contents;
  result.shapeFlag = (result.shapeFlag & ~(8 | 16 | 32)) | (component ? 32 : 16);
  result.patchFlag = -2;
  return result;
}
export default defineComponent({
  name: "SharedLayoutBg", inheritAttrs: false,
  props: { as: { type: String as PropType<"div" | "ul">, default: "div" }, pillClassName: String, inset: { type: Number, default: 20 }, pillContainerClassName: String },
  setup(props, { attrs, slots }) {
    const active = ref<string | null>(null), id = useId(), reduced = useReducedMotion();
    let pointerInside = false;
    function leave(event: MouseEvent) {
      pointerInside = false;
      const root = event.currentTarget as HTMLElement;
      if (!root.contains(root.ownerDocument.activeElement)) active.value = null;
    }
    function blur(event: FocusEvent) {
      if (!pointerInside && !(event.currentTarget as HTMLElement).contains(event.relatedTarget as Node | null)) active.value = null;
    }
    function presence() {
      const rest = reduced.value ? { opacity: 1 } : { opacity: 1, filter: "blur(0px)" };
      const hidden = reduced.value ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, filter: "blur(6px)" };
      return { initial: hidden, animate: rest, exit: (another: unknown) => another ? {} : hidden };
    }
    function row(child: VNode, index: number) {
      const key = child.key == null ? `item-${index}` : String(child.key);
      const slots = child.children && typeof child.children === "object" && !Array.isArray(child.children) ? child.children as { default?: () => VNodeChild } : undefined;
      const body = slots ? slots.default?.() : child.children;
      const pill = h(AnimatePresence, { custom: active.value !== null ? 1 : 0 }, () => active.value === null ? null : h(motion.div, {
        key: "pill-wrapper", variants: presence(), initial: "initial", animate: "animate", exit: "exit", custom: active.value !== null ? 1 : 0,
        class: cn("pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0", props.pillContainerClassName), style: { left: `${-props.inset}px`, right: `${-props.inset}px` },
      }, () => active.value !== key ? null : h(motion.div, { layoutId: `shared-bg-${id}`, transition: reduced.value ? { duration: 0 } : SPRING_LAYOUT, class: cn("pointer-events-none h-full w-full rounded-2xl bg-muted/80", props.pillClassName) })));
      return replaceContents(child, {
        key, class: cn("relative", child.props?.class), onMouseenter() { pointerInside = true; active.value = key; }, onFocusin() { active.value = key; },
      }, [pill, h("div", { class: "relative z-10" }, body as any)]);
    }
    return () => h(props.as === "ul" ? motion.ul : motion.div,
      mergeProps(attrs, { layoutRoot: true, class: cn("flex w-full flex-col", attrs.class), onMouseleave: leave, onFocusout: blur }),
      () => children(slots.default?.() ?? []).map(row));
  },
});
</script>
